title: Triangulatedness of the finite-level compact-support direct image
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $K_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism. Fix a prime $\ell$, write
$\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and require that its image in $K_0$ is invertible.
Choose a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and
put $A=A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every object $c\in\operatorname{Comp}(f)$ of the
compactification category [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], the
functor

$$
 Rf_{!,n}=Rf_{!,n}^{c}:
 D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})
$$

of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] is a triangulated functor [def-weil-triangulated-category]: it
preserves shifts and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished
triangles.

proof.text: Unfold the compactification candidate of [def-weil-compact-support-candidate] in the fixed-coefficient ModuleCat presentation of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. It is definitionally the composite (openImmersionLowerShriek A c.i).mapDerivedCategory followed by (lowerStar A c.g).rightDerivedFunctor, where A = ModuleCat (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n). The source-library exactness instances [lem-sfb-finite-extension-by-zero-exact] supply additivity and preservation of finite limits and colimits for the first underived factor. Its termwise derived functor is triangulated by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated].

ModuleCat of any ring is Grothendieck abelian. The sheaf categories on the small pro-etale sites are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-sfb-proetale-sheaves-grothendieck], and therefore have K-injective resolutions by [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective]. The fixed-coefficient lowerStar of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star] is additive by its source-library lowerStar_additive instance. Consequently its unbounded right derived functor is triangulated by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. No finite-coefficient finiteness theorem, left-exactness theorem in the intrinsic presentation, integral tower, or common-stage construction is required.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-triangulated-functor-composite] to these two factors. Both integer-shift structures are the existing canonical ones, and their composite is exactly the shift structure in the original theorem signature. Thus the compact-support candidate for the arbitrary chosen c is triangulated. Lean synthesizes these instances with infer_instance.
